DEFENSE: AC 29, touch 22, flat-footed 18 (+9 dex, +6 natural, +1 dodge, +2 size)
DR 10/adamantine and magic or crystal and magic; Immune daze, death effects, imperil, mind-affecting, poison, stun; Resist Fire/Ice/Wind/Earth/Lightning/Water 10; SR 23
STATISTICS: Str 12, Dex 28, Con 20, Int 2, Wis 20, Cha 14
Feats Ally Shield, Dodge, Elemental Focus (Wind), Flyby Attack, Greater Elemental Focus (Wind), Outflank, Toughness, Weapon Finesse
SQ Confounding Grace, Improved Uncanny Dodge
SPECIAL ABILITIES: Along with the benefits of the uncanny dodge ability, a penanggalan can no longer be flanked. This defense denies a thief the ability to sneak attack the penanggalan by flanking it, unless the attacker has at least four more thief levels than the penanggalan's HD.

As a standard action, a penanggalan may emit a refreshing hum that closes the wounds of its fellows. All allies within a 30 ft. radius are healed for 3d6 points of damage, are cured of the Poison status effect, and no longer suffer fatigue. Exhausted allies within the radius are instead fatigued. Blue mages can learn this ability as a 3rd-level spell (Knowledge: Local DC 21).

The penanggalan treats all allies within 30 ft. as though they have the corresponding teamwork feats necessary for the penanggalan to gain the benefit of their teamwork feats. The penanggalan's allies do not gain such benefits.
ECOLOGY: At no point is a penanggalan seen without a crowd of chonchons, unless the penanggalan is simply the only one left of its group that has yet to be slain. Though still unintelligent, these flying monsters possess a strange knack for working with the many chonchons and taking advantage of the sheer number of allies they have. They will usually try to stay adjacent to any allies they have to make generous use of teamwork feats and keep themselves out of harm's way while attacking foes with spells, and using life sounding when some are injured; if the penanggalan es life sounding, a number of any surviving chonchons will as well, so as to restore everyone as much as they can. Penanggalans have a five-foot wingspan and weigh about 20 pounds.

rulesDecisions: Actor data preserves the source statblock in biography and builder flags before any Foundry runtime hydration.
Only true feats, spells, and inventory placeholders are eligible for compendium lookup during import; creature-specific special abilities remain custom generated features.
Racial hit dice are generated from the creature type and source hit dice instead of creating class levels.
Source defensive text is mapped into FFD20 trait fields while unusual FF defenses remain preserved as custom text.
Natural attack items use source attack totals, source damage dice, and manual extra attacks for full-attack routines.
Spell and spell-like ability lines create spell placeholders that should hydrate from installed FFD20/PF spell compendiums.
Skill ranks are reverse-calculated from source totals after ability modifiers, racial modifiers, size modifiers, and class-skill bonuses.
